guarantees.claim: b1_inv[0] is continuously assigned the XOR of m11 and mul_b0_c1_inv_buf.
b1_inv[1] is continuously assigned the XOR of b1_inv_buf[0] and mul_b0_q1_buf.
b1_inv[2] is continuously assigned the XOR of b1_inv_buf[1] and mul_q0_c1_inv_buf.
b1_inv[3] is continuously assigned the XOR of b1_inv_buf[2] and mul_q1_q0_buf.
b0_inv[0] is continuously assigned the XOR of m10 and mul_b1_c2_inv_buf.
b0_inv[1] is continuously assigned the XOR of b0_inv_buf[0] and mul_b1_q0_buf.
b0_inv[2] is continuously assigned the XOR of b0_inv_buf[1] and mul_q1_c2_inv_buf.
b0_inv[3] is continuously assigned the XOR of b0_inv_buf[2] and mul_q1_q0_buf.

assumptions.claim: All input signals (m11, mul_b0_c1_inv_buf, b1_inv_buf[0:2], mul_b0_q1_buf, mul_q0_c1_inv_buf, mul_q1_q0_buf, m10, mul_b1_c2_inv_buf, b0_inv_buf[0:2], mul_b1_q0_buf, mul_q1_c2_inv_buf) are correct, independent masked shares, generated according to the chosen masking scheme (e.g., non-zero random masks, uncorrelated shares).
assumptions.risk: If any share is constant, all-zero, or correlated with another share, the masking can be breached, leading to side‑channel leakage of secret key material.

uncertain_points.claim: The set of XOR equations that compute b1_inv[3:0] and b0_inv[3:0] is not accompanied by a specification or reference formula for the GF(2^4) inverse in this masked configuration. It is unknown whether these equations implement a correct inverse in GF(2^4) and maintain the masking arithmetic.
uncertain_points.risk: An algebraic mistake would cause the AES S‑box to produce wrong substitution values, breaking encryption/decryption correctness and potentially compromising any integrity checks that rely on correct ciphertext.

uncertain_points.claim: The combinatorial paths that drive b1_inv and b0_inv may glitch if the input signals (e.g., b1_inv_buf[*], mul_q1_q0_buf, etc.) arrive at different times or toggle non‑simultaneously. Such glitches can expose secret share information through power or timing side channels.
uncertain_points.cond: whenever any used signal changes while the output is observed downstream
uncertain_points.risk: Side‑channel leakage may occur during combinatorial propagation, reducing the effectiveness of the masking countermeasure.
